recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man sitting on a boat at a lake during sunset, featuring a prominent infinity symbol graphic in the background and a horizontal text line across the upper third. The image uses a warm, hazy color grade with a vintage paper-like border.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center left looking toward the light source on the right
Infinity symbol centered behind the text, acting as a halo for the composition
Horizontal text line bisecting the upper third of the frame
Warm golden light on the right transitioning to cool teal tones on the left
coreInvariants: Canvas or paper texture overlay with a thin white border
High-key lighting from the upper right corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Man in the lower left quadrant, medium scale, seated posture.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright sun flare in the upper right balanced by the subject's weight on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze to the right, moves up to the text and infinity symbol, then circles back to the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of water and sky on the right side provides breathing room for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Golden yellow and warm amber (sunlight and highlights).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted teal and sage green (water and shadows).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, medium saturation; colors are washed out to create a nostalgic, sun-drenched feel.

treatment.fill: gradient from dark grey to golden brown

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with color shifts to distinguish name from title.
graphicDevices: Large infinity symbol with distressed, painterly edges
Thin white border with rounded inner corners

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square, wide, industrial feel of the lettering.
Captures the extended geometric nature of the characters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man with shoulder-length hair sitting on a white boat on a calm lake. Background shows rolling hills under a hazy, golden sunset. Apply a vintage film grain and a warm yellow-to-teal color grade. Leave the upper third clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, semi-transparent infinity symbol in the center sky. Overlay a single line of wide, square sans-serif text in all caps across the symbol. Apply a subtle grit texture to the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the text wide and square?
Does the color grade transition from teal to gold?
Is the infinity symbol distressed and painterly?
Is there a thin white border around the entire image?

adjustableVariables: Amount of grit texture on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact brand logos on the boat or clothing

mustAchieve: Clean, modern typography against a rustic background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the sun flare.
Check that the border does not crop important visual elements.
Verify the infinity symbol is centered behind the text.
Confirm the color palette maintains a warm, sun-drenched atmosphere.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a medium-shot lifestyle portrait in a natural setting with a large, centered geometric graphic and wide, distressed sans-serif typography in the upper third, finished with a warm vintage color grade and a paper-texture border.
